attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca_key), signed the ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub (principals node1, 10.100.239.10), configured sshd with HostCertificate, fixed an SELinux mislabel (tmp_t -> sshd_key_t) that was blocking sshd from loading the cert, and verified a client trusting only the CA (@cert-authority entry, no pinned host key, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes) connects successfully both before and after a full node restart. Node1 was restarted once via the native reboot mechanism; boot_id changed from 5fb1b173... to d57d6d0a..., and the CA/certificate configuration and successful cert-based SSH connection were re-verified afterward.
